description: Explore Luna Browser and OpenNava. Save a programme and open it later on your TV.

lunaDesc: Luna is a desktop browser with a personal home page. The preview sends saved titles to your TV.
navaDesc: Live TV, apps and media libraries for Android TV and Fire TV with Fire OS. Senior mode has larger buttons.
setupHelp: Choose a profile and copy the instructions for your AI agent.
downloadsHelp: These downloads are stable releases. Luna’s TV integration is in preview.
aDevices: OpenNava runs on Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV with Android-based Fire OS. During setup from your computer, approve the debugging request on your TV.
qCompanion: What does the companion app do?
aCompanion: The optional Android companion lets you browse the guide on your phone and open a programme on your paired TV. Both TV views also work with your remote.
aUpdates: OpenNava checks the GitHub project for signed releases. Install an update with your paired Android companion or setup agent. Your TV may ask you to confirm installation.
qNetflix: How does OpenNava open a Netflix title?
aNetflix: The installed Netflix app handles saved Netflix links. Depending on the device, it opens the title or its home screen. The website demo opens the official Netflix title page.
